summary: Steep west kerb on a bend, homes 14-18 m away on both sides.
reasons: Bush behind kerb at the top

drivers.seclusion: Wooded block behind the kerb, but homes 14-18 m away on the own side and 18 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerb with no signs; road narrows on the bend, so room to pull fully off is tight.
drivers.traffic: Residential street with through traffic from the roundabout.
drivers.convention: Cars park further down the kerb, from about 50 m, but none at the top.

flags: Steep: about 10% over 15 m, up to 19.6% along the stretch
Verge width on the bend is uncertain
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy, mainly from the west and north.

best_section.where: Kate Street west kerb at the top of the stretch, beside the wooded block on the bend
